method: Real native AUTO/CPU responses on all 27 original photos; 17 reliable nutrition-crop-v2 inputs and 10 full frames. Full-frame attempts are exploratory. Seven-field transport is not admitted for full nutrition; only the separate missing-P/F/C consumer is admitted.

cases.prompt: Read the visible food-package label. Return only JSON with exactly these keys: productName, caloriesKcal, nutritionBasisGrams, proteinGrams, fatGrams, carbohydrateGrams, packageWeightGrams. Use the printed product name in its original language. Transcribe only clearly printed numbers. All nutrition numbers must refer to the same explicitly printed basis. Use null for missing or uncertain fields. Do not estimate, calculate, infer net weight, or substitute whole-dish calories for per-100-g values. Numeric values must be JSON numbers without units; productName is a short string or null.
